text: DIAGNOSTIC COMPLETE (temporary epoch/seq log at commit_replay, reverted after capture): the two -114/EALREADY frames are **(epoch=142, seq=0)** and **(epoch=142, seq=1)** under the test pubkey 41b9e055... — i.e. exactly full_ping's Echo Request (seq0) and its Echo Reply (seq1), RE-DELIVERED after the queue_stats reinit. EALREADY (not fresh-commit) on each means the replay table still contained them: either lichen_replay_table_init (init_link_ctx_locked, lichen_l2_init.c:117) did not run in that reinit window, or the frames were re-committed post-reset before the logged rejections. Leading re-delivery source hypothesis: the l2 tx_queue retry path re-sending already-built frames (same epoch/seq bytes) after module restart — check whether the tx_queue is flushed on disable and whether the retry sweep re-sends entries whose original send succeeded. Note the 1s gap between the two rejections (.350 -> 1.250) matches an NDP/queue retry cadence. ALSO: heft's link_ctx.c had LAST round's uncommitted checkpoint code during this capture — the checkpoint was present and the replay still happened, so the checkpoint is confirmed NOT to alter this symptom (it only fixes same-key seq reset after wipe; these frames are re-DELIVERIES, not re-sends with reset seq). Next implementer: (1) verify the replay table state across the queue_stats reinit (log table generation at init + at commit), (2) audit the tx_queue retry sweep for re-send-after-success, (3) flush the loopback rx_queue AND the l2 tx_queue on disable.
